name: sticking
_: DESIGN 7.3 and 22. A backspin AimSource with contact offset y of -0.7, snapped into a single mib half a metre away, must stop the taw within 0.1 m of where the mib was standing on at least 70 percent of 200 seeds. Watched to fail by zeroing kBack.

asserts.id: the taw hits the mib at all
backspin stops the taw on the mark
how far the taw ended from the mark

_tuning: kBack 3.0 and a 2.6 m/s shot come from a sweep of kBack 2.4 to 3.6 against launch 1.8 to 3.4. At 3.0 the taw sticks on 100 percent of shots from 1.8 to 2.6 m/s and 81 percent at 3.0. Below about 2.0 m/s the taw stops BEFORE it reaches the mib, which is why this scenario also asserts that it hit the thing at all: a stop shot that never arrives would otherwise pass.
